step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram and transcript describe Cepsa's internal talent matching platform. Data flows from SAP/SuccessFactors into an S3 Landing bucket. Arrival of CSV files triggers a Validation Lambda function that verifies schema, writing clean data into an S3 Staging bucket. The staging bucket triggers a Load Lambda, which populates DynamoDB with structured employee profile data. A Step Functions workflow orchestrates node and relationship generation based on profile data and loads it into Amazon Neptune. Finally, both DynamoDB and Neptune feed into an API Gateway that serves a Node/React application used by employees and managers for talent matching.

Step Functions orchestrates node and relationship file generation and loads graph data into Neptune.
